# Data formats

All assets live under `src/main/resources/assets/cobblemon_battle_showtime/`. Resource packs can add or override each
kind under their own namespace. Files marked *generated* are rewritten by a script in `tools/`: edit the script, not
the JSON.

## Moves: `moves/<move id>.json` (generated by `tools/moves.py`)

The file name is Cobblemon's move id (`thunderbolt`, `10000000voltthunderbolt`). Only top-level files with at least
one layer are read; subfolders are ignored.

```json
{
  "category": "special",
  "color": "#FFD81A",
  "accent": "#FFFFB0",
  "size": 1.0,
  "layers": [
    { "motif": "sparks_on", "phase": "wind", "duration": 12 },
    { "motif": "bolt", "phase": "travel" },
    { "motif": "burst", "phase": "hit", "particles": ["minecraft:electric_spark"] }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `category` | `physical` (strikes up close, no travel by default), `special`, `status` |
| `color`, `accent` | The move's colours (default: its type's) |
| `size` | Scale of the whole move (Z-Moves: 1.6) |
| `layers[].motif` | A shape from `move/Motifs` |
| `layers[].phase` | `wind` (user winds up), `travel` (user → target), `hit` (from Cobblemon's hit cue), `self` (on the user only) |
| `layers[].delay`, `duration` | Ticks into the phase; length (0 = the phase's) |
| `layers[].color`, `accent`, `size`, `count` | Per-layer overrides; how many blows, rocks, coins… |
| `layers[].block`, `item` | A block or item the motif draws |
| `layers[].particles` | Vanilla particle ids the motif sprays |

`tools/move_data.json` holds every move's data from Cobblemon's battle engine (type, category, flags, target,
boosts…). `moves.py` has three parts: hand-tuned specs, the composer for every other move, and the Z-Moves.
Shadow Ball has no file: it is the `ShadowBall` class.

## Ambiances: `ambiances/<id>.json` (generated by `tools/ambiances.py`)

Top-level blocks, all optional: `time` (`at`, `speed`), `sky` (`sky_color`, `fog_color`, `strength`, `stars`,
`hide_clouds`), `backdrop`, `spotlights`, `floor_lights`, `floating_blocks`, `lightning`, `aurora`, `shooting_stars`,
`rifts`, `rainbow` (`doubled`), `strobe`, `sound`, `ambient_sounds`, `mirror_ball`, `dance_floor`, `neon_grid`,
`sprites`, `critters`, `nebulae`, `galaxy`, `planets`, `mist`, `veins`, `sky_cracks`, `glitch_cubes`, `wisps`,
`ghosts`, `moon`, `flicker`, `bubbles`, `mushrooms`, `film`, `embers`, `volcano`, `caustics`, `shafts`, `kelp`,
`lanterns`, `fireworks` (a moment can also launch `fireworks` over the field; empty `every`: none far off), `glints`,
`fog_wall`, `mirage`, `birds`, `striped_sun`, `palms`, `wormholes`, `islands`, `island`, `court`, `light_towers`,
`crowd`, `followspots`, `confetti_colors` (moments can also open a `wormhole`, throw `confetti`, fire `pyro`, make
the crowd `cheer`, set off `camera_flashes` and play `notes`), a screen `filter` (and `calm_filter`: the filter with calm
effects on, `"none"` to drop it), and `moments` with `send_out`, `attack`, `crit`, `faint`, `victory`, `defeat`
reactions (a moment can also show a big `text`). Spotlights take `alpha`, `ring`, `sector` and `facing`. `ambiance/Ambiance.java` is the reference for every field and its default. Names shown in the
menu come from the lang key `cobblemon_battle_showtime.ambiance.<id>`.

## Trainer animations: `player_animations/*.json` (generated by `tools/trainer_animations.py`)

Player Animation Library's format (Emotecraft-compatible). Names are `<moment>_<style>`, moments: `guard`, `send_out` (the throw),
`recall`, `attack`, `victory`, `defeat`. Poses are in radians; `torso` moves the whole player (positive pitch tilts
backwards, positive y lifts); elbows and knees use `bend`.

## Screen filters: `shaders/` (generated by `tools/filters.py`)

Post-effect shaders used by ambiances (black and white, pixels, glitch, ripple, old TV): Minecraft 1.21.1 no longer
ships its own.

## Music (resource pack)

`assets/cobblemon_battle_showtime/sounds/music/<battle|victory|defeat>/*.ogg` (and `lobby`, once a mod turns it on), no declaration needed. The
older `assets/phantasmon/sounds/music/` is also read.
File names follow `<game>_<title>.ogg` (`oras_vs_wally.ogg`): `BattleMusic.title` shows it as "ORAS · Vs Wally"
(game codes in `BattleMusic.GAMES`); other names are shown as they are. `tools/music_names.py` renames downloaded
tracks to this convention (game acronym, then the title without "pokemon", "ost", quality tags or numbers). Template: `resourcepack-template/Cobblemon Battle Showtime Resource Pack`.

## Config

`config/cobblemon_battle_showtime.json`:

```json
{
  "ghost": { "stagedCamera": true, "intro": true, "music": true, "ballEffects": true },
  "pvp":   { "stagedCamera": true, "intro": true, "music": true, "ballEffects": true },
  "npc":   { "stagedCamera": true, "intro": true, "music": true, "ballEffects": true },
  "musicVolume": 1.0,
  "trainerProfile": { "guard": "guard_2" },
  "ambiance": "none",
  "checkUpdates": true,
  "cameraVersion": 0
}
```

`ghost` is the settings of battles staged through the API. `config/cobblemon_battle_showtime-music.json` holds the
unticked tracks (`disabled`), the favourites (`favorites`) and `onlyFavorites`;
`config/cobblemon_battle_showtime-intros.json` the same for the intros, by intro name. Both are written atomically; a missing or broken file means the defaults.

## Artwork (`art/`)

- `art/icons/`: sources of the official images, edited with Paint.NET (`.pdn`): the mod icon, the resource pack icon,
  the title banners and the Cobblemon logo used on them.
- `art/ambiances/` and `art/intros/`: the gallery, built by `tools/gallery.py` from in-game recordings: one
  screenshot and one 3-second clip each, and a looping crossfade reel (MP4 and GIFs).

Copies of the icons are shipped at 512 px:
`assets/cobblemon_battle_showtime/icon.png` and the template pack's `pack.png`. Regenerate them after editing a source.
